regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: Retell a changed meeting plan
lessons.objective: Retell a French message in new words while preserving who changed the plan, the new day, and the room.
lessons.focus: Read Leïla a déplacé la réunion à jeudi dans la salle bleue, then hide the line and tell a colleague what changed. Keep Leïla, jeudi, and salle bleue in the retelling; the sentence can change while those facts stay intact. Compare phrase rhythm with a reviewed model after the first attempt.

words.fr: Leïla a déplacé la réunion à jeudi dans la salle bleue.
words.en: Leïla moved the meeting to Thursday in the blue room.

words.fr: La réunion aura lieu jeudi dans la salle bleue.
words.en: The meeting will take place Thursday in the blue room.

words.fr: Je transmets le message à ma collègue.
words.en: I pass the message to my colleague.

words.fr: Je vérifie le nouvel horaire avant de répondre.
words.en: I check the new schedule before replying.

reader.fr: Leïla a déplacé la réunion à jeudi dans la salle bleue.
reader.en: Leïla moved the meeting to Thursday in the blue room.

reader.fr: Elle envoie un message à Karim pour expliquer le changement.
reader.en: She sends Karim a message to explain the change.

reader.fr: Karim cache le message et dit à sa collègue que la réunion aura lieu jeudi dans la salle bleue.
reader.en: Karim hides the message and tells his colleague that the meeting will take place Thursday in the blue room.

reader.fr: Sa collègue vérifie le nouvel horaire avant de répondre à Leïla.
reader.en: His colleague checks the new schedule before replying to Leïla.

grammar.focus: A déplacé reports the completed change; aura lieu gives the event's future time and place.

examples.fr: Leïla a déplacé la réunion à jeudi dans la salle bleue.
examples.en: Leïla moved the meeting to Thursday in the blue room.

examples.fr: La réunion aura lieu jeudi dans la salle bleue.
examples.en: The meeting will take place Thursday in the blue room.

speaking.opening: J'ai un message de Leïla à propos de la réunion.
goals: Give the new day and room.
Confirm the colleague understood both details.
speaking.complication: The colleague remembers the day but names the wrong room; retell the message with the room made clear.
speaking.closure: Oui, la réunion aura lieu jeudi dans la salle bleue.

see.prompt: Identify the person, new day, and room that must survive the retelling.

recall.answerRef: La réunion aura lieu jeudi dans la salle bleue.

say.answerRef: La réunion aura lieu jeudi dans la salle bleue.

lessons.title: Confirm a name and address
lessons.objective: Give a French name, street address, and apartment number so a listener can repeat them accurately.
lessons.focus: Say Camille Durand and 24, rue des Lilas in complete phrases, then slow the name and numbers when the listener asks. Keep the street and apartment numbers separate; check the listener's repeat-back instead of relying on volume alone.

words.en: I live at 24 Rue des Lilas.

words.fr: Le numéro de l'appartement est le douze.
Pouvez-vous répéter le nom et l'adresse ?
words.en: Can you repeat the name and address?

reader.fr: Camille Durand appelle l'accueil pour confirmer son adresse.
reader.en: Camille Durand calls reception to confirm her address.

reader.fr: Elle dit : « J'habite au 24, rue des Lilas. »
reader.en: She says, 'I live at 24 Rue des Lilas.'

reader.fr: L'agent note la rue, puis demande le numéro de l'appartement.
reader.en: The agent notes the street, then asks for the apartment number.

reader.fr: Camille répond « le douze » et demande à l'agent de répéter le nom et l'adresse.
reader.en: Camille answers 'twelve' and asks the agent to repeat the name and address.

grammar.focus: Je m'appelle introduces a person's name; j'habite au introduces the numbered street address.

examples.en: I live at 24 Rue des Lilas.

speaking.scene: Confirming an address with a reception agent
goals: Give the street number and street name.
Give the apartment number and ask for a repeat-back.
speaking.complication: The agent repeats apartment twelve as street twelve; distinguish 24, rue des Lilas from apartment twelve.
speaking.closure: Merci, le nom et les deux numéros sont corrects.

see.prompt: Separate the name, street address, and apartment number in the three phrases.
wordRefs: Le numéro de l'appartement est le douze.

hear.prompt: In the reviewed address recording, distinguish the street number from the apartment number.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence giving apartment number twelve.
type.answerRef: Le numéro de l'appartement est le douze.

say.prompt: Ask the agent to repeat the name and address.
say.answerRef: Pouvez-vous répéter le nom et l'adresse ?

write.prompt: Write the person's name, street address, and apartment number as three distinct facts.

lessons.title: Distinguish prices and times
lessons.objective: Keep French fifteen/fifty and thirteen/thirty contrasts clear in a station exchange.
lessons.focus: Compare quinze and cinquante in ticket prices, then treize and trente in a departure time. Say the numbers inside complete phrases; a listener's correct price and time matter more than speed.

words.fr: Le train part à treize heures trente.
Le train part à treize heures cinquante.

reader.fr: À la gare, Samir croit que le billet coûte cinquante euros.
reader.en: At the station, Samir thinks the ticket costs fifty euros.

reader.fr: L'agent répète que le billet coûte quinze euros.
reader.en: The agent repeats that the ticket costs fifteen euros.

reader.fr: Samir demande si le train part à treize heures cinquante.
reader.en: Samir asks whether the train leaves at 1:50 p.m.

reader.fr: L'agent confirme le prix et précise que le départ est à treize heures trente.
reader.en: The agent confirms the price and clarifies that departure is at 1:30 p.m.

grammar.focus: À treize heures trente and à treize heures cinquante give two different departure times; coûte gives the ticket price.

examples.fr: Le train part à treize heures trente.

speaking.scene: Correcting a ticket price and departure time
speaking.opening: Bonjour, je voudrais confirmer le prix et l'heure du départ.
goals: Repeat the corrected price and time together.
speaking.complication: The traveler hears fifty euros and 13:50; correct both numbers in complete French phrases.
speaking.closure: Merci, le billet coûte quinze euros et le train part à treize heures trente.

see.prompt: Compare the two prices and the two departure times; underline each changed number word.
wordRefs: Le train part à treize heures trente.
Le train part à treize heures cinquante.

recall.prompt: Recall the sentence giving the corrected fifteen-euro price.

hear.prompt: In the reviewed station recording, distinguish quinze from cinquante in the ticket price.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence giving the 13:30 departure.
type.answerRef: Le train part à treize heures trente.

say.prompt: Correct the mistaken fifty-euro price in a complete sentence.
